data.change_summary: Applied all three pending amendments: (1) extracted migration/deserialization logic into SaveFile::from_value(Value) with from_json delegating to it, and updated tank_api's post_load handler to call from_value directly, eliminating the Value→String→Value round-trip; (2) removed dead SimError::SchemaVersionMismatch variant — no code path constructed it after the migration to SchemaVersionTooNew/SchemaVersionTooOld; (3) replaced the truncating `as u32` cast with u32::try_from that rejects out-of-range schema versions as SchemaVersionTooNew instead of silently wrapping.
outstanding_risks: The v2→v3 migration is frozen as raw-JSON logic independent of WaterState::rescale_totals_for_volume; this is by design for migration immutability (carried forward from prior rounds, unchanged)

steps.description: Extracted SaveFile::from_value(mut value: Value) containing all migration and deserialization logic; from_json now parses the string then delegates to from_value.
Updated crates/tank_api/src/handlers/save.rs post_load to call SaveFile::from_value(payload) directly instead of serializing the Value to a String first.
Removed SimError::SchemaVersionMismatch { expected, actual } variant from crates/tank_core/src/types/actions.rs — confirmed zero usages remain in the codebase.

Replaced `v as u32` truncation with u32::try_from(raw_version) in from_value; overflow now returns SchemaVersionTooNew { actual: u32::MAX, max_supported: SCHEMA_VERSION } instead of silently wrapping to a low version number.
Ran cargo test (all 148 tests pass), cargo clippy -- -D warnings (zero warnings), cargo fmt --check (no diff).

cargo clippy -- -D warnings: zero warnings across all crates
